title: Contact with a being and taken aboard a craft at the fire tower
place_text: Blue Ridge Mountains near Boone, North Carolina

tellings.quote: and then there was this creature that came over and he she I don't know was maybe about 5t tall beautiful deer-like eyes came over and touched me on my right shoulder.
this is where my specialty came in back in after my contact experience in 73
tellings.difference: Only a passing mention with no details of the being or the craft; it presents the experience as the root of his specialty.
tellings.link_reason: Greer's own 1973 contact experience is the fire-tower contact story, from the same year and the same witness.

plain: Steven Greer, a doctor who campaigns for the government to reveal what it knows about UFOs, told podcast host Jesse Michels that in October 1973, at a fire tower in the Blue Ridge Mountains near Boone, North Carolina, he met a being and was taken aboard a craft. He says the creature was about five feet tall with beautiful, deer-like eyes, and that it came over and touched him on his right shoulder. Greer describes this contact as the root of his later life's work, which would mean humans can meet such beings directly.
